# ComplexLODs — complete reference (lod.michitai.com)

ComplexLODs is a feature-preserving level-of-detail generator for Unity
6000+ (URP). It ships as an editor extension with its own simplification
stack — no third-party code — plus this static demo site where the same
algorithm runs in the browser. Copyright (c) 2026 MICHITAI; proprietary.
Contact: support@michitai.com.

## Architecture

Editor stack (C#, Assets/ComplexLODs/Editor):

- Quadric — Garland-Heckbert symmetric 4x4 error quadric, plus the
  probabilistic triangle quadric of Trettner & Kobbelt 2020 (expected QEM
  under isotropic Gaussian vertex noise, sigma = 5% of mean edge length,
  area-normalised so fine detail stays numerically visible next to large
  flat faces).
- MeshGraph — position-welded vertex graph: welded vertices, corners and
  wedges (per-corner attribute sets for normals/tangents/UVs/color/skin
  weights), undirected edge map, boundary and seam detection.
- QEMSimplifier — edge-collapse simplifier driven by a min-heap of quadric
  costs.

Web stack (this site, zero dependencies):

- engine/ — server-side only, never served: simplifier.js (JS port of the
  editor Core), loaders.js + fbx.js (OBJ/FBX/STL/GLB/PLY parsing),
  exporters.js (OBJ/STL/PLY/GLB/FBX-ASCII writers), zip.js (STORED zip
  writer), jobworker.mjs (worker_threads job runner).
- public/js/objio.js — Wavefront OBJ parse/serialize; the only parser
  shipped to the browser (used for preview display).
- public/app.js — three.js viewer + upload UI.
- server.js — static files + the generation API.

Input formats: OBJ, FBX (binary 7.x incl. zlib-compressed properties — model
node TRS baked in, and ASCII without transforms), STL (ascii+binary), GLB and .gltf
(embedded/data-URI buffers; node TRS transforms applied; triangle
primitives only; sparse accessors and external .bin unsupported), PLY
(ascii + binary_little_endian; vertex normals/uvs).

## Collapse rules

- Placement is constrained: collapse targets are the edge endpoints, plus
  the midpoint only on edges still coinciding with a real source edge
  (phantom tracking: inherited/moved edges are phantom).
- Feature chains: a vertex on a boundary/crease/seam/submesh/non-manifold
  edge may only collapse along the chain. Straight-run vertices can be
  consumed; corners and junctions stay; non-manifold endpoints are locked.
- Moved vertices interpolate normals/tangents/UVs/color along the source
  edge's wedge chart; a move without an unambiguous attribute partner (or
  with differing skin weights) is rejected.
- Integrity checks never relax: link condition, duplicate-face rejection,
  boundary-loop topology guard, flip/sliver(shape-factor)/growth rejection,
  collapse distance bounded by 4x local feature scale.
- Silhouette locks: vertices on the 2D convex hull of any of 14 viewing
  projections (6 axes + 8 body diagonals) are locked for the whole run.
- Interior-release ladder gated by target depth (target/source ratio):
  >=0.75 stage 0 only; >=0.5 stage 1 (interior chain corners); >=0.25 stage
  2 (interior verts move freely); <0.25 stage 3 (interior boundary loops
  may dissolve if they share no silhouette vertex). releaseStage is
  reported per level.

## Options (SimplifyOptions)

targetTriangleCount, weldTolerance, boundaryWeight (500), lockBoundaries,
creaseAngle (35 deg), creaseWeight (25), seamWeight (40), extremesWeight
(6) / extremesPower (3) radial extremity importance, lockTopVertices,
lockBoundsExtremes, useVertexColorImportance + vertexColorChannel +
importanceMax (10), preventFlips, neverCollapseLocked, preserveTopology
(link condition), preserveBoundaryLoops, recalculateNormals, progress /
cancelRequested callbacks.

## Pipeline behaviour

- Per-level targets: sourceTriangles / reductionRate^level; presets
  Performance 3x2.5, Balanced 4x2.0, Quality 6x1.6; custom ratios allowed.
- MinSimplifyTris = 256: tiny children reuse the source mesh.
- Levels are always decimated from the LOD0 source — never chained.
- Identical-geometry levels share one mesh asset and one renderer object.
- Regeneration destroys prior generated clones; authored LOD content is
  only disabled, never deleted.
- Preflight drops zero-area source triangles.
- Texture LODs: optional per-level downscaled textures + material variants.
- Output: per-level report (target vs. actual tris, collapses, release
  stage, max/rms error, boundary-loop counts, warnings).

## Web demo API

POST /api/generate?preset=balanced — raw model bytes in the body,
X-File-Name header; responds application/x-ndjson stream:
'parsed' {vertices, triangles}, 'progress' {level, collapses, srcTris,
alive, target}, 'level' {index}, 'done' {id, levels, expiresAt, srcTris,
srcVerts}, 'error' {message}. Limits: 64 MB upload, one running job per
connection, ~30 jobs/hour/IP.

GET /api/preview?id&i — LOD i as .glb (viewer preview; parsed client-side
by the tiny public/js/glbmini.js reader).
GET /api/file?id&i — LOD i in the uploaded format (attachment).
GET /api/zip?id — all levels in one .zip.

Lifetime: uploads and generated files live under store/<jobId> and are
deleted after TTL (default 30 min, env LODS_TTL_MIN); a sweeper also
evicts oldest-first if the store exceeds 1 GB. Expired jobs answer 410.
